lines: When I'm hurt
I'd be glad if you'd gently hold me close
When I fall and can't get up
Please give me a little courage
My longing stays forever undelivered
Today again, alone in this cold city
I can't even remember where this is
In this endless night, I have one wish
"A light to shine in a starless sky"
Even what I threw away in a place I can't return to
Will be reborn and surely light tomorrow
Among the stardust, I met you
I wish we could have met still carrying the feelings of that day
Even the tears I cried over a past that won't come back
Will be reborn and surely
Light up tomorrow for me
When I can't sleep
I'd be glad if you'd quietly take my hand
"The dawn will come,"
whisper to me — even a lie will do
My wish stays forever ungranted
Tonight, take the constellations away
They've vanished — there's no going back now...
In this endless night, I have one wish
"A light to shine in a starless sky"
Even a star too far away now, too fleeting
Will be reborn and surely light the night sky
The miracle of meeting among the stardust
Will vanish again into the crowd
To the nights I cried over a past that won't come back
I say goodbye — tomorrow will surely
Let me shine
Such a small constellation, and yet
You noticed
That I was here
Thank you

"A light to shine in a starless sky"
Even what I threw away in a place I can't return to
Will be reborn and surely light tomorrow
